subject: literacy
concept: Tracing how a literary movement (e.g. Romanticism, Realism, Modernism) reflects the historical period it emerged from
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to History's period studies — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student matches literary movement characteristics to historical events/conditions occurring at the same time
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an excerpt's style and concerns to the literary movement it likely belongs to
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a described literary movement reflects the historical conditions of its time

misconception_flags: identifies a literary movement's features without connecting them to any real historical cause

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
